violation_type.title: AP Safety Precautions for Loading and Unloading Children - No Child Unattended (26 TAC §746.5605(4))
violation_type.short_title: AP Safety Precautions for Loading and Unloading Children - No Child Unattended
violation_type.typical_finding: It was determined that a child in care was left unattended in a vehicle owned and operated by the operation.

finding_variants.text: It was determined that a child in care was left unattended in a vehicle owned and operated by the operation.

Based upon the information obtained during the investigation, sufficient evidence was available to support, the driver failed to follow the facilities procedures regarding safety precautions for loading and unloading children which resulted in a child being left in the center's vehicle unattended.
The standard was evaluated as related to the investigation. The DFPS investigation revealed that a child in care was left unattended on a vehicle.
During the follow-up inspection the operation was found in compliance as the caregiver responsible for leaving a child on the bus was terminated.

Based on the information gathered during the DFPS Investigation, a child was left unsupervised for approximately 20 minutes inside the transportation vehicle after being picked up from school. Caregiver was unaware of child?s whereabouts. Child was found by a parent who passed by the vehicle who noticed that the child was knocking on the window.
A child was left unattended in the transportation van by two separate caregivers.
